name: quill
description: Desktop agent that watches Slack and keeps only the items that need your attention.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
